newsitem.title: UK: UK to announce London Docklands railway franchisee.
newsitem.headline: UK to announce London Docklands railway franchisee.

text.p: The British government will on Monday give further details of its plans to privatise the Docklands Light Railway, which links central London with its docklands business centre to the east, government sources said.
They said Environment Secretary John Gummer will give a substantive written answer to a question on Monday's parliamentary order paper.
Sources said the statement, at about 1530 GMT, will name a franchisee to run the complete railway for a seven-year term. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7767
